Internal helper: jtable() given charts alone

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_figure_call.Rd

Each chart made a figure (ruling R63, Session 411): in the call's style when it names one – the chart drawn again in that style's look (the S412 audit's F6) – else in the style it was drawn in. The call's title, note and source make one figure's, so a call of several charts takes none of them; a table's own inputs – headings, markers, a table type's settings – a chart takes none of (Session 415). Ruling R72's note for each figure that shows a name or a code; then the report, and the file.

Usage

.jst_figure_call(
  charts,
  x_sub,
  style,
  title,
  note,
  source,
  given,
  over_q,
  landscape,
  out_path,
  overwrite,
  open,
  print,
  cl,
  mc
)

Arguments

charts

The charts, a list.

x_sub

The call's first argument as typed.

style

The call's style, resolved, or NULL.

title, note, source

As jtable()'s.

given

Logical, named headings and markers: which the call gave.

over_q

The call's style settings, as typed.

landscape

NULL, or the call's page setting, checked.

out_path, overwrite, open, print

As .jst_table_finish().

cl, mc

The call and the matched call.

Value

The figure, or the figures together (class "jst_tables"), invisibly.
